description: List and search Security Case Evidence from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Security Case Evidence objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Security Case Evidence. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.

_id.description: Query operators for _id field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

createdAt.description: Query operators for createdAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

createdByUserId.description: Query operators for createdByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

deletedAt.description: Query operators for deletedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

deletedByUserId.description: Query operators for deletedByUserId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

description.description: Query operators for description field of type Very Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

fileId.description: Query operators for fileId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

fileName.description: Query operators for fileName field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

fileSizeInBytes.description: Query operators for fileSizeInBytes field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

fileType.description: Query operators for fileType field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

kind.description: Query operators for kind field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

name.description: Query operators for name field of type Long Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

projectId.description: Query operators for projectId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

securityCaseId.description: Query operators for securityCaseId field of type Object ID. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Includes

sha256.description: Query operators for sha256 field of type Text. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, Search, Includes

updatedAt.description: Query operators for updatedAt field of type Date. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

url.description: Query operators for url field of type URL. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull

version.description: Query operators for version field of type Number. Supported operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween

select.description: Optional: field names to return for each Security Case Evidence (e.g. ["_id", "name"]). Omit to get all readable fields. Large fields excluded by default (request explicitly if needed): description.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Default: 0. Example: skip=10 to start from the 11th record.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Use "ASC" for ascending or "DESC" for descending. Example: {"createdAt": "DESC"} to sort by newest first.
